annotation_unicode.nfd_scope:
Freeze Python 3.12/UCD 15 scanner properties and IPS-domain NFD/casing.

No general-purpose normalizer is shipped: a cluster is accepted only if its
first scalar decomposes to ASCII plus permitted marks and every subsequent
scalar decomposes solely to permitted marks. Reordering cannot change this
predicate. Original clusters, not their decompositions, are cased and emitted.

unicode.compiler_unicode: Rust compiler Unicode properties and casing are never consulted
unicode.lowercase_equivalence: Python default lower has one language-independent contextual mapping, Final_Sigma. Capital Sigma U+03A3 is Uppercase, so accepted fallback input can contain it only at index zero. Final_Sigma requires a preceding cased character, which is impossible there. Thus per-scalar full lower mappings equal whole-string lower on this accepted input domain. Later titlecase scalars are permitted and must also be lowered.
unicode.scalar_digest_format: For every Unicode scalar in ascending numeric order: u32 little-endian scalar, u8 Python isupper (0/1), u32 little-endian byte length of Python scalar.lower(), then its UTF-8 bytes; surrogates excluded
unicode.scope: Simple-query fallback only; no normalization, case folding, locale tailoring, or annotation casing
unicode.selection: Only first scalar Uppercase and no later scalar Uppercase; return a variant only when the lowered string changes
